# CPDataKit v0.9.3

CPDataKit v0.9.3 completes the schema and atomic-output follow-up fixes.

- Distribution metadata now identifies the package as Beta.
- Atomic text publication records a warning and continues when permission preservation raises an OS error, while normal NTFS permissions remain preserved.
- Comparison summary formatting and diff-check evidence are cleaned up.
- Schema validation rejects `string` fields with `allow_missing=True`, a backward-incompatible change for third-party schemas using this combination; set `allow_missing=False` and provide text values.

Local validation completed with **1421 passed, 1 skipped** and **90.0655%** coverage.
Regression evidence is recorded in `docs/verification/2026-09-27-followup/`.

```bash
python -m pip install --upgrade "cpdatakit==0.9.3"
```
